methods.name: SMDRF-Net (Semi-supervised Multi-temporal Deep Representation Fusion Network)
methods.summary: A semi-supervised deep learning framework for landslide mapping that integrates multi-level deep representation learning (DRL) and multi-temporal deep representations fusion (DRF). It uses WGAN-GP for unsupervised feature extraction via transfer learning and an attention-based mechanism to capture spatio-temporal dependencies, optimized using pseudo-labels generated via unsupervised object-level change detection and uncertainty analysis.
methods.source: Xiaokang Zhang, Man-On Pun, and Ming Liu
methods.verbatim: To this end, a deep learning model based on semi-supervised multi-temporal deep representation fusion network, namely SMDRF-Net, is proposed for reliable and efficient LM.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are not linked or publicly available, and the custom SMDRF-Net code lacks a repository or persistent link.
